flow cytometry.sample_type: blood and tissue mononuclear cells / sorted memory CD8+ T cells
flow cytometry.readouts: T cell subset frequencies, intracellular and surface protein expression (including TCF-1, CXCR4, LEF-1, Perforin, T-bet), proliferation dye dilution, percent T-bet-positive cells

evidence_location.quote: In all donors, TCF-1 expression by CD8 + TEM in LN was significantly higher than that found in CD8 + TEM derived from blood, BM, spleen, and lung ( Fig. 1B ).

RNA-Sequencing.readouts: whole-transcriptome gene expression, differential gene expression signatures, transcriptional clustering

evidence_location.quote: We initially analyzed differential gene expression between memory CD8 + T cells in LN and BM of three individuals (see sorting strategy, Fig. S1 ), identifying over 2,000 differentially expressed (DE) genes conserved between individuals

CyTOF.sample_type: cryopreserved cell suspensions / CD8+ T cells from LN, BM, spleen, lung, and blood
CyTOF.readouts: high-dimensional protein expression profiles and tissue-specific clustering of CD8+ T cell subsets

evidence_location.quote: We used cytometry by time-of-flight (CyTOF) to define a protein expression signature of LN memory CD8 + T cells relative to other sites based on the transcriptional profile identified above.

T cell proliferation assays.sample_type: sorted memory CD8+ T cells from BM, LN, spleen, or lung; in some experiments whole mononuclear cells from blood, BM, or LN
T cell proliferation assays.readouts: proliferation after anti-CD3/CD28 or CMV peptide stimulation measured by eFluor450 dilution; expansion of CMV-specific CD8+ TEM cells

evidence_location.quote: When stimulated with anti-CD3/anti-CD28 antibodies, LN memory CD8 + T cells exhibited greater proliferation compared to counterparts in BM, spleen and lung ( Fig. 6A, C ).

aliases: sequencing of the TCR CDR3β variable (V) regions
Human T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing.sample_type: DNA from memory CD8+ T cells / CD8+ TEM cells from LN and BM
Human T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing.readouts: TCR Vβ/CDR3β clonotypes, clonality, diversity, richness

evidence_location.quote: Importantly, BM memory CD8 + T cells consistently had higher clonality compared to LN memory CD8 + T cells ( Fig. 7A ).
